guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以「以水量、排水路徑和污染負荷設計滲出水收集的教學模型」為主軸，依序處理滲出水產生與水量邊界、穿孔管有效通流、泵送揚程與輸送、有機與鹽分輸出負荷、液位與流量感測校正。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on Model leachate collection through water balance, drainage paths and pollutant loading, progressing through Leachate generation and water boundary, Perforated-pipe conveyance, Pumping head and transfer, Organic and salt export load, Level and flow calibration. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
procedure: 只將 P 改成 0.10 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 200 變成 400 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Δz 改成 1.0 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變成 2 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將內徑 D 改成 0.08 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.63662 變成 0.994718 m/s。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Qin 改成 40 m³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變成 80 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 H 改成 20 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.26385 變成 3.01846 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 p1 改成 2200 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1200 變成 1600 Pa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Q 改成 150 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30 變成 37.5 kg/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Q 改成 40 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變成 15 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 C 改成 100，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變成 10 concentration units。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
procedureEn: Change only P to 0.10 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 200 to 400 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Δz to 1.0 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3 to 2 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only internal diameter D to 0.08 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.63662 to 0.994718 m/s. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Qin to 40 m³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 40 to 80 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only H to 20 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.26385 to 3.01846 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only p1 to 2200 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1200 to 1600 Pa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Q to 150 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 30 to 37.5 kg/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Q to 40 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 20 to 15 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only reference C to 100, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 6 to 10 concentration units. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
evidence: 針對「滲出水產生與水量邊界」，將雨量、量測排水與含水變化對齊，對未知項給區間而非強制零殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「集排水層坡向」，用固定基準點重測縱橫斷面，找出局部反坡而非只量兩端。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「穿孔管有效通流」，核對真實內徑與流量，再觀察沖洗前後壓力、固體沉積和流量恢復。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「集水槽尖峰暫存」，比較液位曲線導出的儲量與泵流量積分，測試假想停泵事件的容量餘裕。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「泵送揚程與輸送」，同時讀取液位、流量、壓力和電力，核對實際工作點。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「堵塞與差壓診斷」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「有機與鹽分輸出負荷」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「調勻池停留與混合」，先扣除無效空間，再用示蹤或批次記錄核對停留時間是否分散。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「液位與流量感測校正」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「備援與長期維護」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
evidenceEn: For Leachate generation and water boundary, Align rainfall, measured drainage and moisture change; bound unknown terms rather than forcing zero residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Collection-layer grades, Resurvey longitudinal and transverse sections against stable benchmarks to detect local reverse grades. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Perforated-pipe conveyance, Verify actual internal diameter and flow, then compare pressure, deposits and flow recovery before and after cleaning. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Peak sump storage, Compare level-derived storage with integrated pump flows and test capacity margin under a hypothetical pump outage. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Pumping head and transfer, Read levels, flow, pressure and power together to verify the actual operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Clogging and pressure diagnosis, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Organic and salt export load, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Equalization residence and mixing, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Level and flow calibration, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Backup and long-term maintenance, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
pitfalls: 忽略儲水變化會把短期蓄水誤認為永久減滲。 在「滲出水產生與水量邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
端點高差正確仍可能在中間存在窪地。 在「集排水層坡向」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
使用外徑或名目尺寸代替有效內徑會低估速度。 在「穿孔管有效通流」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只用日平均流量會忽略短時暴雨造成的積存。 在「集水槽尖峰暫存」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
管道堵塞會提高阻力，固定額定功率不代表固定流量。 在「泵送揚程與輸送」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「堵塞與差壓診斷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「有機與鹽分輸出負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
把幾何容積當有效容積，會掩蓋短流與未處理區。 在「調勻池停留與混合」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「液位與流量感測校正」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「備援與長期維護」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
pitfallsEn: Ignoring storage change mistakes short-term retention for permanent seepage reduction. Mark where this error can enter the Leachate generation and water boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Correct endpoint elevations can still conceal a depression between them. Mark where this error can enter the Collection-layer grades flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Using outer or nominal diameter instead of effective inner diameter understates velocity. Mark where this error can enter the Perforated-pipe conveyance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Daily mean flow misses storage needed during short storm peaks. Mark where this error can enter the Peak sump storage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Pipe blockage raises resistance; a fixed motor rating does not imply fixed flow. Mark where this error can enter the Pumping head and transfer flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Clogging and pressure diagnosis flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Organic and salt export load flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Using geometric volume as effective volume hides short-circuiting and untreated zones. Mark where this error can enter the Equalization residence and mixing flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Level and flow calibration flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Backup and long-term maintenance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

courses.summary: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。
courses.summaryEn: The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.
